items.q: Where do SLEDMC candidates come from?
items.a: SLEDMC candidates are pre-screened professionals sourced directly from Sri Lanka, where they undergo rigorous technical, language, and cultural preparation through SLEDMC Academy.

items.q: Which sectors can SLEDMC provide workers for?
items.a: We specialize in Commercial Drivers (C/CE), Hospitality & Culinary, Care & Healthcare Support, Logistics & Warehousing, and Skilled Trades (Welding, Electrical, Mechanics, Construction).

items.q: Can candidates receive destination-specific language preparation?
items.a: Yes. SLEDMC Academy delivers tailored language training (English, German, Italian, Dutch) focused on workplace safety, supervisor instructions, and industry vocabulary.

items.q: How does the Professional Driver programme work for European employers?
items.a: We source drivers holding heavy vehicle licenses, train them on EU road rules, digital tachographs, defensive driving, and cargo securing, and prepare them for Code 95/CQC pathways with accredited partners.

items.q: Who handles international immigration and legal work permit procedures?
items.a: SLEDMC coordinates with licensed mobility, legal, and immigration partners to handle all required work permit applications, embassy appointments, and document legalizations.

items.q: How can European employers submit a workforce requirement?
items.a: Employers can fill out our online Request Workforce Form below or contact our business development team directly to initiate a talent pipeline proposal.
